errors.name: BookNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested book is not found in the library database.

errors.name: MemberNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested member is not found in the library database.

errors.name: LoanNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested loan record is not found in the database.

errors.name: BookAlreadyBorrowedError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to loan a book that is already borrowed by another member.

errors.name: MemberNotEligibleForLoanError
errors.description: Raised when a member is not eligible to borrow books due to inactive membership status.

errors.name: LoanDateAfterReturnDateError
errors.description: Raised when a loan date is provided after the return date, which is logically invalid.

errors.name: BookAvailabilityStatusError
errors.description: Raised when an invalid availability status (e.g., 'available', 'borrowed', 'reserved') is provided for a book.
